---
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: '1'
  NEXTEST_PROFILE: ci
  PACT_DO_NOT_TRACK: 'true'

jobs:
  # MARK: Sentinel

  complete:
    name: CI complete
    if: always()
    needs:
      - test
      - compat
      - ffi
      - musl
      - features
      - wasm
      - clippy
      - release-deps
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Fail if any job failed
        if: contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')
        run: exit 1

  # MARK: Cross-platform

  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.os }})
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.draft
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1

      # Windows builds are dominated by filesystem overhead; ReFS Dev Drives
      # avoid most of it.
      - name: Set up Dev Drive
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        uses: samypr100/setup-dev-drive@562171fe8df7401fdf582d766cd3b6ab80d5b1a0  # v4.1.0
        with:
          drive-size: 12GB
          workspace-copy: true
          env-mapping: |
            CARGO_HOME,{{ DEV_DRIVE }}/.cargo
            RUSTUP_HOME,{{ DEV_DRIVE }}/.rustup

      - name: Resolve workspace root
        shell: bash
        run: echo "WORKSPACE_ROOT=${DEV_DRIVE_WORKSPACE:-$GITHUB_WORKSPACE}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install macOS dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: brew install shared-mime-info

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@ecabd13d1c56bd1345c230e542e9144811ad706f  # v2.0.0
        with:
          build-warnings: warn
          cache-workspaces: ${{ env.WORKSPACE_ROOT }}/rust -> target
          cache-save-if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' }}

      - name: Install tools
        uses: jdx/mise-action@08ae2a091c038e1e05ec6f5115dc5c69d5a2a6b8  # v5.1.2
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          working_directory: ${{ env.WORKSPACE_ROOT }}
          cache_save: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' }}

      - name: Run tests
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKSPACE_ROOT }}/rust
        env:
          RUST_LOG: debug
        run: cargo nextest run --workspace

      # nextest does not run doctests. This step and the ones below run even
      # when nextest fails, so one failure does not hide the rest.
      - name: Run doctests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKSPACE_ROOT }}/rust
        run: cargo test --workspace --doc --no-fail-fast

      - name: Run mock server log test
